description: A three-storey modern townhouse with a glass-railed balcony and a rooftop terrace under a pergola. The main floor is open concept, with wide-plank wood floors, recessed lighting and tall windows on two sides. The kitchen has a waterfall-edge stone island, flat-panel cabinets, a built-in stainless fridge, a glass-door wine fridge and wall ovens. A wide opening off the kitchen leads to a side courtyard with a green wall. The primary bedroom has corner windows and a door to its own balcony. Its bathroom has a freestanding tub, a glass walk-in shower and a floating wood vanity. On the upper level, a sitting room opens through a sliding glass wall to the roof terrace, which has a fire table and lounge seating.
highlights: Rooftop terrace with pergola and fire table
Built-in wine fridge and wall ovens
Freestanding tub and glass walk-in shower
review_notes: Photos clearly show a Southern California setting (looks like a Los Angeles-area planned community): tall palm trees in photo-2, photo-3, photo-4, photo-5, photo-6 and photo-9, plus palms along the street in main.jpg. This does not fit Ontario; consider replacing these photos or accept the mismatch for a dev sample.
Neither Niagara nor Muskoka is a natural fit; St. Catharines (Niagara) chosen because the photos show an urban townhouse, not a cottage. Muskoka would fit worse.
